[SWS_PHM_00227]
{DRAFT}
Switch Global Supervision Status from
kFAILED
to
kOK
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kFAILED
, the
Elementary Super-
vision Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kOK
and
no supervision is in
Elementary Supervision Status kFAILED
or
kEXPIRED
,
then the
Platform Health Management
shall change the
Global Supervision
Status
to
kOK
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transition (10) in figure 7.6.
